text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But I did place, so I managed to run a
good race.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That means my skills are improving!
Right,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Only because you've been
guiding me.
choice_data_list: That's proof of how hard you work every day!
That's proof of how hard you work every day!
I've got to work even harder.
We've got to work even harder.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But I've still got room for improvement. I
can't be
resting on my laurels!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm brimming with energy right now! I'll
keep up
the hard work!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah... I guess you feel the same way too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I've got my eyes on being the top
Umamusume in
all of Japan... I can't be
satisfied with what I've
already achieved.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All righty! I'll give it everything I've got
from here
on out! Wooo!
